selection: One median non-comment canonical-solution length task per each of 26 top-level categories; replace the classical GHZGame and MagicSquareGame medians with quantum protocol tasks 2.2 and 2.6; add CHSHGame/2.4 and KeyDistribution_BB84/1.2 as stochastic threshold stress tests. Selection is fixed before execution; this is an engineering pilot, not a representative performance sample.
seed_policy: Native upstream behavior: no added seeds and no edits to reference solutions or tests. Record finite repetitions; do not infer absence of rare stochastic failures.
